messages:
lina: Nova flagged 14 H100s at LHR intake: 5 DOA, 3 serial swap, 6 minor cosmetic dings. They asked if we want air replacements for DOA or accept depot repair.
dom: drop AWB and depot photos pls. need to triage for warranty.
vendor-nova: AWB: NV-445-7788
Carrier: JetFreight
ETA: 2025-08-10 09:40 BST
Depot: LHR-Depot-5
Photos: https://nova.example/photos/NV445-7788.zip
Issue: 5 DOA (fan failure), 3 serial swapped, 6 cosmetic dents (no functional impact)
procurement-bot: PO RC-4710: warranty covers DOA. expedite preapproval $12k. expense code CAPEX-ENG-HW.
lina: infra impact: EU pool can spare 4, we need 6 to keep SLAs. air 4 units now, schedule 1 repair and 4 ground-replace after serial reconcile?
dom: prefer to air 5 DOA if within budget. which units are critical? any firmware mismatch?
vendor-nova: all same PN, no firmware mismatch. serial swaps are packing errors. We can do 4 air immediate, 1 next-day air if needed. Ground-repair ETA 7 days. Air surcharge $1,100/unit.
lina: ok authorize air for 4 now, hold the 3 swapped for audit at LHR-Depot-5 for 5 days. Nova to provide CSV manifest pre-pickup.
procurement-bot: recording RMA tag rma:RC-4710-NOVA-1. expedite funds allocated.
vendor-nova: RMA issued: RMA-NV-9901. AWB updated NV-445-7788 (RMA-NV-9901). Pickup 2025-08-11 02:00 UTC. CSV manifest link: https://nova.example/csvs/RMA-NV-9901.csv
dom: thanks. I'll update routing to avoid affected hosts and add +10% buffer. post AWB when final.
lina: closing unless new issues, will reopen if manifest shows more mismatches.
